annotations.title: Add an image to the media library from a URL

description: Downloads one image into the media library without attaching it to a post, and returns its id and address, ready for featured_image or a post body. search-media first: importing the same picture twice leaves two copies. Only JPG, PNG, GIF and WebP within the site’s upload limit. The address must end in the file’s extension, and the file must really be that image. ⛔ SVG is refused because it can carry a script. Only use an image the owner has the right to use. Limited to 30 media writes an hour for each connection.

alt.description: What the picture shows, in one plain sentence (≤250 chars). Write it now: a picture without one gets flagged.

caption.description: Its caption. Scripts and event handlers are refused.

description.description: Its description. Scripts and event handlers are refused.

title.description: Its title in the library. Named after the file when omitted.

name: agentimus-import-media

height.description: 0 when unknown or not an image.

id.description: The attachment id: featured_image takes this.

note.description: Not empty when what is stored differs from what was sent.

url.description: The file’s public address, ready to use in a post body.

width.description: 0 when unknown or not an image.
